name: FrameThrower API
description:
Search a film stills library indexed frame by frame on lighting, lens character, shot size, camera angle, colour palette and mood — in plain language, by reference image, or by colour.

Responses carry metadata, thumbnail URLs, colour palettes and deep links. **Never raw image bytes** — this is a reference and discovery API, not an image-delivery pipe. The frames are not ours to license and rights remain with their owners.

**Pricing:** $2 of credits free on signup, no card and no plan required. Then $1 = 1,000 credits; a search costs 2, so $1 buys 500 searches. Credits never expire and there are no rate limits. Every metered response carries `X-Credits-Cost` and `X-Credits-Remaining`.
